upstream_servers.description: List of DoT upstream servers to use. Each entry specifies the IP address and optionally the FQDN for certificate verification.

address_data.description: IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) of the upstream DoT resolver (e.g., 8.8.8.8, 2001:4860:4860::8888)

fqdn.description: Fully qualified domain name (FQDN) used for TLS authentication (e.g., dns.quad9.net). Optional but recommended.

authentication_mode.description: How to authenticate the upstream server: 'name' (verify certificate against FQDN), 'pubkey' (pin public key)

cacert_file_or_path.description: Path to CA certificate file or directory (e.g., /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt or /etc/ssl/certs). Leave empty to use system store.

tls_min_version.description: Minimum TLS version to require: 'tls1.2' or 'tls1.3'. TLS 1.3 is preferred if upstreams support it.

listen_addresses.description: IP addresses (IPv4/IPv6) to bind the local DNS listener to. Include '0.0.0.0' or '::' to accept remote queries (not recommended for privacy).

listen_port.description: Local port to listen on for DNS queries. Standard DNS uses port 53.

dnssec.description: IP version preference: 0=IPv4 only, 1=IPv6 only, 2=both (default). Use 3 to force IPv6 for upstream.

dnssec_validate.description: Enable DNSSEC validation: 0=disable (unsafe), 1=enable strict validation (recommended), 2=aggressive NSEC validation

cache_size.description: Maximum number of DNS responses to cache. Smaller (50–150) for embedded devices; larger (1000+) for servers.

cache_min_ttl.description: Minimum time (seconds) to cache a response. 0 uses RR’s TTL. Non-zero overrides minimum (e.g., 60–300).

cache_max_ttl.description: Maximum time (seconds) to cache a response. Default is 24h (86400). Helps prevent stale cache.

retry_attempts.description: Number of retries to attempt before failing a DNS query when upstream is unreachable.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds per upstream query/connection. Typical: 2–5. Increase for high-latency networks.

prefer_ipv6.description: Whether to prefer IPv6 connections to upstream servers. Set true only if IPv6 is reliable.

round_robin_upstreams.description: Rotate through upstream servers instead of using first-available order. Improves load balancing.

use_tls_session_tickets.description: Use TLS session tickets to resume connections (faster reconnection). Disable for strict privacy (reduces tracking but increases latency).

add_tls_query_padding_blocksize.description: Padding blocksize (bytes) for TLS queries to obscure traffic patterns. Must be power of two ≤ 1232; 0 disables padding.
